evidence.quote: found that a “break” in the power-law behavior of the true CMF is indicated between $\sim$5 to $15 \ M_{\odot}$

referee_caveats_inferred: Number-correction factors reach >~20 for the far sample near 1 Msun, so the lowest-mass true CMF bins are unreliable
Break mass is quoted inconsistently: ~5 to 15 Msun in abstract/conclusion, ~4 to 15 in the PPL section, ~3 to 10 in the comparison section
Frequency is given as 1.3 mm in the abstract and as near 1.4 mm for ALMAGAL in Source Selection
Clump distance minimum is 0.79 kpc in text while Table 1 lists 0.76 kpc for G320.24; distance source not stated
Single-clump core counts for Q analysis are small (10 to 33), limiting the clustering conclusions
Environmental interpretation rests on a comparison of different samples and methods, not a controlled test
